definitions.explanation: The feeling of disgust, hatred, or strong dissatisfaction with oneself, often following a failure, mistake, or recognition of one's own shortcomings.

examples.japanese: ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{自己嫌悪|じこけんお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}った→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧。
examples.english: I fell into self-loathing after making the same mistake again.

examples.japanese: {自己嫌悪|じこけんお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苛|さいな}まれている→苛む：28648_sainamu⟧。
⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{過|す}ぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧しまい、{自己嫌悪|じこけんお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}った→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧。
examples.english: I said too much and fell into self-disgust.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧ (self) + ⟦{嫌悪|けんお}→嫌悪：05998_keno⟧ (loathing, disgust)

Both components are Sino-Japanese compounds:
- ⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧ = {自|じ} (self) + {己|こ} (oneself)
- ⟦{嫌悪|けんお}→嫌悪：05998_keno⟧ = {嫌|けん} (dislike) + {悪|お} (bad, evil)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自己嫌悪|じこけんお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧ - to fall into self-loathing
- {自己嫌悪|じこけんお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苛|さいな}まれる→苛む：28648_sainamu⟧ - to be tormented by self-hatred
- {自己嫌悪|じこけんお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ - to feel self-disgust
- {自己嫌悪|じこけんお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}られる→駆る：14715_karu⟧ - to be driven by self-loathing

USAGE:
Describes a strong negative emotion directed at oneself. Common after:
- Making mistakes
- Failing to meet one's own standards
- Behaving contrary to one's values
- Feeling inadequate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自己批判|じこひはん}→自己批判：22766_jikohihan⟧ - self-criticism
- ⟦{自責|じせき}→自責：14885_jiseki⟧ - self-blame
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{責|せ}める→責める：02284_semeru⟧ - to blame oneself
- ⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧ - regret
- ⟦{反省|はんせい}→反省：03570_hansei⟧ - reflection, remorse (milder)

REGISTER:
Slightly formal/psychological. Common in written Japanese, introspective contexts, and discussions of mental health.
